verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for an AI gateway, but the evidence never shows AI Gateway issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for agents. Per-user/project budget and rate limits via Dynamic Routing, and gateway-wide rate limiting, are adjacent usage controls rather than credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
